name: q1-relay-disc
description: the hand-wired relay sheet (400 cells, no mutation or turnover), the signals view; a touch of the signal pipette at its left edge at 8 s

evals.js: const f = await moire.tissues.focus('relay', 1.5); moire.relayAt = f; const c = await moire.signals.now(); return JSON.stringify({f, n: c.n, junctionCells: c.junctionCells})
const f = moire.relayAt; moire.signals.drop(f.x - 17 * moire.cells.R, f.y, 3.5); return 'poked'
const c = await moire.signals.now(); return JSON.stringify({firing: c.firing, emitters: c.emitters, wave: c.wave})
